status: Declared before capacity model implementation and selection scoring; not external preregistration
primary_target: Quarterly all-service T2 Z ASM per aircraft-day assigned for represented passenger/combined NB/WB aircraft rows, summed over detailed financial regions within an exact certificate carrier
scope: T2-covered aircraft exposure, not total owned inventory, consolidated marketed capacity, monthly seasonality or an identified spare/crew/hub ceiling. Preserve reverse P52 omissions and discrepancies. No transfer of existing P52 coefficients.
features: Intercept; target-specific lag 1 and lag 4; five carrier/group offsets; group-specific Q2/Q3/Q4 seasonality. Standardize features on fitting rows only, with an unpenalized intercept.
training_sample: Require source-eligible capacity, utilization and productivity, with their eligible lag-1/lag-4 state, on common training targets for both architectures. At least eight training targets per carrier/group. No imputation or fallback.
forecast_rule: Frozen 2013-19 coefficients; recursive intermediate predictions without post-origin observations. Direct capacity and productivity predictions bounded below at zero; utilization bounded [0,24]. Decomposed capacity equals the product of predicted utilization and predicted productivity.
common_selection_sample: Same actual targets and baseline inputs for every declared candidate. Withhold a comparison if source eligibility, recursive lag or baseline state is missing; preserve all exclusions and sample counts.
selection_metric: Lowest equal-weight mean of 18 carrier/group/horizon MAEs in ASM per assigned aircraft-day. Ties use architecture order then declared penalty order. Do not use 2024+ target values for fitting, selection or design changes.
interpretation: A statistical quarterly capacity component. Selection comparison does not establish whole-engine, causal policy, monthly, locked-test or investment validation. Overlapping horizons are not independent observations.
uncertainty: Point comparison first; parameter/structural uncertainty, calibrated intervals and convergence remain proposal requirements.
vintage: Current-download reconstruction acquired October 9, 2026; no historical point-in-time forecast claim
